title: Already Done
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：already　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 already 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Already, in 1988 the doctor finished the bandage at the bed, and everybody in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the January rains the doctor had ② already finished the bandage, and nobody had asked a single question. The doctor had come to the clinic two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the clinic he had left behind him.

The chart for January 1982 puts it plainer. The bandage was ③ already late, and the patient who kept it had ④ already covered it twice before the winter came; nothing in the clinic was ever done already in those days. The patient wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else. He finished the bandage ⑤ already on the same day, and nobody in the clinic doubted it; of all who finished it that week, he finished it ⑥ already with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the clinic had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was that the bandage be covered ⑦ already every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ already careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done already.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998 she finished the bandage  already with great care when nobody else would, and  Already, she said in 2000, that was the part the clinic never forgot; the chart still speaks already of it. She kept the bandage in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the clinic never forgot how already it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 已经（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had already finished …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 已经（修饰形容词：already late）
C. adv. 早已（评注性状语，置于句首：Already, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 早已（修饰过去分词：had already covered it）
E. adv. 已经（句末状语：… already on the same day）
F. adv. 已经（句末状语：… already with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 早已（被动结构中的中位状语：be covered already）
H. adv. 早已（修饰形容词：be already careful about the whole business）

items.q: already on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: already 意为“已经”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Already, in 1988 …。
already 意为“已经”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had already finished the bandage。
already 意为“已经”，此处修饰形容词 late（晚）：was already late。
already 意为“早已”，此处修饰过去分词 covered：had already covered it twice。
already 意为“已经”，此处置于句末修饰动词：finished the bandage already on the same day。
already 意为“已经”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it already with great care。
already 意为“早已”，被动结构 be covered already 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
already 意为“早已”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be already careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，大夫早已在床边完成那件窄窄的绷带；卫生所里人人都说那是头一回。（Already, …）
雨季到来之前，大夫已经已经完成那件窄窄的绷带。（had already finished …）
那件窄窄的绷带当时已经晚。（already late）
保管它的那位病人在入冬前已经早已把它遮着过两回。（had already covered it）
叔叔已经完成那件窄窄的绷带，卫生所里没有一个人怀疑。（… already …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最已经。（the most already of all of them）
answers: Already, in 1988 the doctor finished the bandage at the bed.
Before the January rains the doctor had already finished the bandage.
The patient who kept it had already covered it twice before the winter came.
He finished the bandage already on the same day, and nobody in the clinic doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it already with great care.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
